Discover the unique world of the Proboscis monkey, an Old World primate endemic to the island of Borneo. These fascinating animals live in the mangrove forests and coastal swamps along the island's rivers.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
